name: Porterhouse Road Play Area
description: Ripley Town Council's play area on Porterhouse Road, for ages 2 to teens. It has a junior multi-unit, step logs, a wobble bridge, a balance beam and a balance rope trail, plus a spring horse and a four-way springer. For older children there's a basketball hoop and two five-a-side goals. There are benches and litter bins, and it's open all day, every day.
